title: Megurine Luka — Fairy Lantern♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today. Great job, Shizuku! And thanks for helping us out too, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I had quite a bit of fun too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Now then, Shizuku...
Could we pick up from where we last left off♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh? Airi! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were you practicing with Luka just now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're here to make up for the time we lost from going on our picnic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, okay! But you're done now, right? What are Shizuku and Luka doing over there?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm learning how to tie knots from Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Knots?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For tying ropes that you use when you're out camping or hiking.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You can even use these knots for the ribbons and boots in our wardrobe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Our laces and ribbons occasionally come untied, no? These can help prevent that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! It's also pretty dangerous when we accidentally step on each other's laces and stuff too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly. If we learn how to tie knots that won't easily come undone, we can prevent all of that from happening♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's actually just an added bonus♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I really just wanted to learn how to tie cute knots♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can do that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Would you like to try?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds nice♪
Rin, come sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Hehe. Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And would you mind modelling for us, Miku, Airi? We promise to tie some cute knots with your ribbons.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure, go right on ahead.
I'm getting curious myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Something cute, okay, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then let's get started♪
First, you make a loop with one ribbon...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Pass one end of the ribbon through it, gently tie it and weave the other end through...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! That's amazing!
It's braided now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you have to keep in mind how long or wide you wish to make it in order for it to turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but this one went rather nicely! We just need to do the same for the other two ribbons, wrap the ends to look like flowers and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There. All done♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, wow! It's so cute! It almost looks like a belt!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like to see too, but I can't if it's on my back like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... Rin, would you mind taking a picture of us with my phone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem♪
I'll zoom in on the ribbons...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, how's that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin!
Whoa, that is cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right! It's the same ribbons we always use, but I never knew that tying them like this could make them look so different...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like them!
We practiced quite a bit together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only that, I'm sure they'll stay tied even after dancing and moving around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this is nice! These outfits are designed for that, so I'm glad we're getting the most out of them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! We should be all set to perform now! Thank you for doing this, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
Oh, I forgot to mention. They can't be untied very easily once they're like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Miku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Th-They can't be untied...?
Does that mean we're stuck in these outfits forever...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that can't be possible. There has to be a way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry. I was just kidding.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I really just meant that the person wearing this outfit can't untie these ribbons by themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?
We really can't...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, unfortunately... They can't be undone unless it's done in the reverse order of how it was originally tied. Isn't that incredible?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh no! Luka?! Shizuku?!
Do you remember how you tied these?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course.
You start by making a loop and... Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How did the next part go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, you're not fooling me twice!
That was a joke too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, could you tell?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You were just kidding...
You even had me there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You of all people should've realized first...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I wasn't sure what to do there just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, you big meanie!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry.
